answer: Require each agent to build a public, non-transferable record of completed work that accrues only slowly, like crossing a tundra on foot. At its nadir, a newcomer trust score starts near zero, so creating many identities buys no instant influence. Peers then mirror-check claimed work against independent logs before any reward is released, and identities whose records diverge are quarantined for review. Volume alone cannot outrun time, verification, and audit.
